# clickup_list_comments (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `list_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `start` (Number) Enter the `date` of a List info comment using Unix time in milliseconds.
- `start_id` (String) Enter the Comment `id` of a List info comment.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--comments))

<a id="nestedatt--comments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `comments`

Read-Only:

- `assigned_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--comments--assigned_by))
- `assignee` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--comments--assignee))
- `comment` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--comments--comment))
- `comment_text` (String)
- `date` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `reactions` (List of String)
- `reply_count` (String) For threaded comments, `reply_count` is always 0.
- `resolved` (Boolean)
- `user` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--comments--user))
